entities.summary: Henk Peeters was a Dutch artist. He was an active member of the ZERO movement. Peeters was born in The Hague. He studied Fine Art at the Koninklijke Academie voor Beeldende Kunsten in The Hague and taught from 1957 until 1972 at the Art Academy in Arnhem, the Netherlands. Until his death, Henk Peeters restored artworks from the Nul period and remained an active spokesman for the Nul group.
